title: DH speaker series
description: Over the course of three sessions, brought together six guest speakers and 60 total attendees comprising undergrads, grad students, faculty, and MILA researchers.

title: Culture-oriented NLP
description: Using word embeddings, compared protagonist word associations in book reviews on female-led versus male-led Young Adult novels to explore reader gender bias.

title: Data storytelling
description: Processed survey responses from Montreal lawyers, worked with legal clinic to create fictional migrant profiles, and calculated each profile's likelihood of receiving legal aid.

title: "In Words and Numbers"
description: Examined literary language and science communication both quantitatively and qualitatively (e.g., statistically significant words; close reading).

title: 公公
description: Poem about the pursuit of intra-familial communication within a multi-generational immigrant family

title: ML fundamentals
description: Implemented K-Nearest Neighbours, Decision Tree, Logistic + Multi-class Regression, and Multi-layer Perceptron models from scratch to classify textual, numerical, and image-based data.

title: Birthday card for Iris
description:
Pale sky, silver pond
Watch the time and petals drift
Another year: new dawn
Our hearts grow brighter

title: Delicious MOO ice cream
description: An exploration of a fictitious ice cream company. I especially liked the idea of the flowers blooming from the dripping ice cream, suggesting a sort of subverted revitalization.

title: The magic of late night moonlight
description: That strange ephemereality of late night study / work / computer sessions. Published alongside an article I wrote for the Bull & Bear.

title: IN
description: A collection of images I associate with programming. Notice the cat mousepad, curiously inverted tree, and Adam's finger reaching towards technological salvation.

title: Terror
description: A representation of terror. Though the shoe lifts from the chewing gum, the latter remains stuck. This tactile discomfort paired with the psychedelic background and the lefthand quote serve to emphasize this state of nonbeing.

title: "Tongue In Cheek"
description: Tracked the representation of the tongue from a figure of speech in autobiographical slave narratives to a concretized body part in contemporary ones.

title: Sappling
description: Three graphics charting the growth of a small plant overlooking a lake. Created for a corporate sustainability campaign.

title: YOP wireframe
description: Webpage design + implementation for a local nonprofit helping at-risk youth.

title: Les chutes Sainte-Marguerite
description: Small painting of a cool spot my boyfriend showed me in Sainte-Adèle, Québec. Acrylic on wood
